blocks.text: 🪝 WPI Base Year Revised to 2022-23=100 & 3 Producer Price Indices (PPIs) Introduced. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Replaces 2011-12 base year to address WPI (wholesale price index tracking producer inflation)'s 55% GDP service exclusion and double-counting bias.
New Base Year: WPI (wholesale price index tracking producer inflation) base year updated to 2022-23=100 by Office of Economic Adviser (OEA), DPIIT.
3 New PPI Series: Output PPI (OPPI), Trial Input PPI (IPPI), and Service PPI (covering 7 Phase-1 services).
SNA Alignment: Aligns Indian price statistics with International Monetary Fund (IMF) and System of National Accounts (SNA) standards.
New WPI (wholesale price index tracking producer inflation) base year (2022-23=100) vs previous base year (2011-12=100).
